Gondian Lanpos Biggs is a dead member of the Church of Gond in Act Three.

Involvement

Act Three

Lanpos' corpse can be found in the lab level of the Steel Watch Foundry at X: -1948 Y: 422. If using  Speak with Dead, he reveals that the banites forced his husband  Manser Biggs to beat him to death, because he discovered their sons  Grindo and  Hastar are held captive in the Iron Throne.

Notable loot

  • Parchment (Steel Watch Foundry)

Speak with Dead

Lanpos Biggs can be spoken to with  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Gondian Lanpos Biggs
      Lanpos... Gondian...
  • What is going on here?
    • Gondian Lanpos Biggs
      Banites came... took over the Foundry... forced us to make... the Steel Watchers...
  • How did you die?
    • Gondian Lanpos Biggs
      The Banites had my husband beat me... for eavesdropping...
      • What did you hear?
        • Gondian Lanpos Biggs
          The prison... the Iron Throne... it's underwater. Submersible... under warehouse... docks...
      • How many guards are in the building?
        • Narrator
          *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*
  • How do I disable the Steel Watch?
    • Gondian Lanpos Biggs
      Toobin... only Toobin knows...
